headline: Phillies arrive at Fenway Park while Patriots fans wait for the schedule
morning_brew: Fenway Park is hosting the Phillies tonight and the squad needs a spark. A record of seventeen wins and twenty-three losses through the first stretch of the season is tough to stomach. Brandon Marsh is coming in hot for Philadelphia, and our pitching staff has to find a way to keep him off the bases. It is a long season, but these quiet nights from the lineup are starting to pile up. We need more than just one or two guys showing up if we are going to climb back into the race.

Thursday is the big day for the Patriots with the league finally dropping the full schedule. There are nine international games on the slate this year, and everyone is wondering if the local boys are headed overseas. Rookie tight end Eli Raridon is the name on everyone's lips down at minicamp right now. Just play the kid, what are we waitin' for? Drake Maye needs those big targets to develop fast so this offense can actually move the chains this fall.

Offseason talk is dominating the scene at the Garden while the winter teams figure out their next moves. Fans are still thinking about the Larry Bird era apex as a reminder of what dominant basketball looks like in this building. Looking at the mock drafts and free agency lists is fine, but the front office needs to be aggressive. This city does not do rebuilds gracefully. We expect to be in the mix every single year, and right now there are more questions than answers about the roster depth.
